\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R147-first-pass-looking-back}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an advert and a receipt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} recently, already, last, once, to spend
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Recently? (\textbf{\bn{সম্প্রতি}}, \emph{sômprôti}.) Already? (\textbf{\bn{আগেই}}, \emph{āgei}.) Last? (\textbf{\bn{গত}}, \emph{gôtô}.) Once? (\textbf{\bn{একসময়}}, \emph{æksômôy}.) To spend? (\textbf{\bn{কাটানো}}, \emph{kāṭāno}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking ahead and reading signs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R147-second-pass-looking-ahead-and-reading-signs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for next and after this.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item next, after this, a plan, to decide, to hope
  \item a timetable, a notice, rent; a fare, an advert, a receipt
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Next? (\textbf{\bn{আগামী}}, \emph{āgāmī}.) After this? (\textbf{\bn{এরপর}}, \emph{erpôr}.) A plan? (\textbf{\bn{পরিকল্পনা}}, \emph{pôrikôlpônā}.) To decide? (\textbf{\bn{স্থির} \bn{করা}}, \emph{sthir kôrā}.) To hope? (\textbf{\bn{আশা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{āshā kôrā}.) A timetable? (\textbf{\bn{টাইমটেবিল}}, \emph{ṭāimṭebil}.) A notice? (\textbf{\bn{নোটিশ}}, \emph{noṭish}.) Rent; a fare? (\textbf{\bn{ভাড়া}}, \emph{bhāṛā}.) An advert? (\textbf{\bn{বিজ্ঞাপন}}, \emph{bigyāpôn}.) A receipt? (\textbf{\bn{রসিদ}}, \emph{rôsid}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
